about_the_game: In this action-adventure game, you are an ex-mafia member who seeks revenge for the death of your best friend. Receive upgrades when defeating mafia bosses. Throughout the game, you can upgrade your powers and decide to either take over the city or free it from anyone of high power.
detailed_description: In this action-adventure game, you are an ex-mafia member who seeks revenge for the death of your best friend. Receive upgrades when defeating mafia bosses. name: Skylark

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: i3-4160 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 950 / AMD 270 (min 2GB video ram)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 4770K, 3.4 Ghz or AMD Ryzen 5 1600, 3.2 Ghz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB or AMD Radeon RX 480, 8GB
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
